method: Decode with each checkout's openpilot.tools.lib.logreader.LogReader and matching cereal schema.
Execute official process_replay.replay_process with random OpenpilotPrefix and fake-event synchronization, separately for plannerd and controlsd.
Include recorded supplemental SunnyPilot state, GPS and vehicleParameters subscriptions; retain official process triggers.

Rebuild current CarParams/CarParamsSP through the checkout's actual CarInterface using recorded CAN fingerprint and firmware family list, then publish through prepare_drive_config before CarParams on custom branches.

The recording used fixed fingerprinting: stock replay would discard its recorded firmware list and leave the custom controller ineligible. The offline initialization callback explicitly preserves those recorded fields.
Custom-mode trials populate the reviewed firmware confirmation only inside the temporary replay Params namespace; this is a fixture assumption, not ECU firmware proof or a physical-device change.
Start each process from the same empty process/learned state and replay the continuous segment without resetting at individual frames.
Inspect every floating-point output field for finiteness and compare matched command/plan values across branches.

limitations: Recorded model predictions are consumed; corrected Bigv2 inference, native AMD execution, map pixels and camera warping are not executed in this replay.
This is not closed-loop vehicle simulation. Only plannerd/controlsd run in isolated replay namespaces; card, pandad and CAN transmission never run.
The custom controller matches source command values to float32-scale roundoff; the ordinary controller command values match pinned sp-steer exactly for this fixture.
Longitudinal plan speeds/accelerations/jerks/aTarget/shouldStop match the source exactly for this fixture; that does not establish bit-for-bit equivalence for every possible scenario.
Eight of1178 planner publications are invalid in both branches due to recorded-input timing/availability; none contains nonfinite numerical output.
Host replay elapsed times are not comma4 real-time performance measurements or proof of vehicle safety.
